title: BitterASM
blurb: A metalanguage for constructing assembly languages that assumes practically nothing about the target architecture.

title: An Infrastructure for Large-Scale Empirical Analysis of C-to-Rust Software Migrations
blurb: An in-progress research project  that uses static analysis and machine learning to measure and display the possible costs of a C-to-Rust migration.

title: QGuider
blurb: A fluent, object-oriented Python library for downloading and scraping Harvard's student-submitted course reviews (QGuides), with over 375 downloads on PyPI in under 30 days.

title: Chickadee OS
blurb: A UNIX-like multiprocessor teaching OS, implementing virtual memory, process and thread management, system calls, PC Speaker support, and designing a virtual file system (VFS) abstraction.

title: FirstAid-LLM
blurb: A first-aid chatbot that uses a large language model (LLM) using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) of over 180+ quality first-aid documents to provide accurate first-aid information.

title: DP Summarization
blurb: A research project that created and implemented two distinct algorithms that apply differential privacy (DP) to tasks surrounding summarizing private documents.

title: DPClustering
blurb: A research project that implements a Python package to investigate the application of differential privacy (DP) to common clustering algorithms.

title: check50
blurb: A Python library that provides a framework for writing and running automated tests for student code, used by over 5 million students and educators.
